claims.claim: Independent quantum-error-correction provider Riverlane states that its Deltaflow 2 real-time QEC system has been deployed on Infleqtion systems, alongside deployments on Oxford Quantum Circuits, Oak Ridge National Laboratory and Rigetti. This independently supports the existing execution thesis that Infleqtion is integrating external QEC infrastructure into real hardware workflows rather than relying only on issuer-described forward roadmaps.

risks.risk: A deployed QEC stack supports technical execution but does not by itself establish utility-scale economics, customer revenue, or fault-tolerant commercial advantage.

contradictions.contradiction: Independent deployment evidence strengthens execution credibility while Riverlane still describes continuous real-time error correction at utility scale as an ongoing roadmap objective rather than a completed industry endpoint.

unknowns.unknown: The deployment disclosure does not quantify Infleqtion-specific error rates, logical-qubit economics, deployment scale, or revenue contribution.

learning.changedStrategy: Used an independent technology-provider/counterparty source rather than another issuer or SEC origin to strengthen execution provenance.
learning.nextLawfulAction: Council Alpha may reuse this source-addressed execution evidence when constructing source-integrity/data-confidence and underwriting evidence; do not infer numeric economics from the deployment alone.
